extensions.name: Mobile Conversations Button
extensions.description: Phone-only floating Conversations button for Desktop that opens the existing mobile conversations drawer, becomes a same-location close X while the drawer is open, and exposes long-press shortcuts. 仅在手机上显示的浮动对话按钮：打开移动端对话侧边栏，侧边栏打开后就地变为关闭图标，并支持长按快捷菜单。
